name: Fresh Coconut Water
description: Naturally sweet electrolyte-rich water drunk straight from a green tender coconut, cut open at street stalls.
ingredients: a handful of crushed green cardamom pods
a handful of fresh cilantro, chopped
a generous spoonful of roasted cashews
instructions: Combine the basmati rice and whole milk in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the ground coriander and lemon wedges, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 0 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with plain yogurt, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
tips: Serve in a chilled glass for the most refreshing result on a hot day.
Adjust the sweetness gradually, tasting as you go — you can always add more plain yogurt, but you cannot take it away.
